scope: 45 mounted HTTP operations; summary MCP protocol remains separately inventoried

operations.auth: No local permission requirement; production auth context middleware still runs
operations.behavior: Read public liveness and hard-coded service version; no database readiness probe.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; config:read
operations.behavior: Read flattened branding with nullable title/icon and locale map. Requires a non-nil user and config:read.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; config:update
operations.behavior: Replace branding; omitted fields reset to defaults. Locale keys normalize lowercase, titles trim (500 characters max), at most 30 locales; icon URL derives from uploaded key. Invalid/unuploaded keys return422.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; config:update
operations.behavior: Upload FormData with file as its first field. PNG/JPEG/WebP signature and MIME must match; nonempty image at most8MiB. Returns asset_key and URL; malformed, oversized and unsupported files return400/413/415.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; config:read
operations.behavior: Read LiveKit/recording/AI settings with secret-presence booleans; secrets are never returned.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; config:update
operations.behavior: Replace LiveKit settings. Missing/null/blank secret fields preserve existing secrets; omitted audio_processing_enabled becomes false, audio_language defaults auto. Model refs may clear with null. Invalid URLs, language, schedules and model configuration return422.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; integration:read
operations.behavior: Read browser integration steps and code snippets with the configured public LiveKit websocket URL.

operations.auth: No local permission requirement; production auth context middleware still runs
operations.behavior: Read the two stable assistant tool schemas (session_list and session_detail). This route has no local permission gate.

operations.auth: Own user plus assistant_session:read_own OR room_recording:read_own OR room:read_recordings; OR assistant_session:read_all/room_recording:read_all. * and session:* accepted
operations.behavior: List the specified user participant rooms by newest activity. q searches room name; limit defaults20 and clamps1..100. Latest analysis is restricted to that user and transcript truncates to1200 characters.

operations.auth: Own user plus assistant_session:read_own OR room_recording:read_own OR room:read_recordings; OR assistant_session:read_all/room_recording:read_all. * and session:* accepted
operations.behavior: Read one room only if the specified user is a participant; missing membership/room returns404. Own access filters analyses to that user; read_all includes all room analyses. DRM manifest and model analysis remain provider-owned JSON.

operations.auth: Trusted server-only x-infera-lms-token matching LMS_SERVICE_TOKEN
operations.behavior: Read trusted LMS notification state. Header x-infera-lms-token must match LMS_SERVICE_TOKEN (403 on mismatch,503 if missing/provider unavailable). This read can persist learning start and an outbox event; LiveKit probe timeout is5s.

operations.auth: No local permission requirement; production auth context middleware still runs
operations.behavior: Read public flattened branding and nullable runtime-validated feedback_task_origin. This origin cannot be saved through branding.

operations.auth: No local permission requirement; production auth context middleware still runs
operations.behavior: Read public raw branding image bytes with immutable cache headers. Invalid/missing UUID.extension key returns404; this is not a JSON envelope.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room_recording:read; aliases room_recording:read_all, room:read_recordings
operations.behavior: Page recording queue with page_number/page_size (default1/10, page>=1 and size1..100), escaped literal search and exact status filter. Returns recordings and meta; sorted by started_at descending.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room_recording:read; aliases room_recording:read_all, room_recording:read_own, room:read_recordings
operations.behavior: Read typed recording tracks and analyses; missing recording returns404. Own read requires current room-client membership; global/admin scopes are accepted. Analysis remains model-owned JSON.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room_recording:process
operations.behavior: Schedule ready/scheduled/failed recording processing; raw_capturing/processing/archived/deleting or raced transitions return409. process_at is timezone-free ISO datetime. Omitted/null optional audio fields preserve current values.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; config:read
operations.behavior: Read normalized Agentic audio model catalog using configured financial owner or current config user; missing owner/upstream failure returns502.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room_state:respond; aliases room:read_own
operations.behavior: Respond as a current participant to question/task/game state. Staff cannot answer questions/tasks. values are required; evidence_images defaults empty. Failed task validation returns200 with validated:false, without persisting completion. Accepted replies may advance the active cohort and emit rewards.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read; aliases room:read_all, room:read_own
operations.behavior: List rooms with page_number/page_size (default1/10; supply positive values), custom_only and normalized Persian/literal search. Returns data.rooms without pagination metadata. status is numeric; current_state uses Rust enum variant casing.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:create; aliases room:read, room:read_own
operations.behavior: Create a room with required name/capacity/starts_at; starts_at is timezone-free ISO datetime. Room-state names use PascalCase (ChargeLow), numeric room status defaults1. Composition rooms materialize DRM state later. Returns200 data.room.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:delete
operations.behavior: Delete room and dependent records; returns200 data.room snapshot of the deleted room, not a generic deleted boolean. Missing room returns404; started-room media cleanup is best effort.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read; aliases room:read_all, room:read_own
operations.behavior: Read room detail with nullable timestamps/current_state and numeric status. Requires preview access or own room membership; missing room returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:update
operations.behavior: Partially update a room via PUT or PATCH (same handler). Omitted/null optional fields preserve values; users/states arrays synchronize membership/states. Before start, timing/state edits reset lifecycle; after start progress is retained. Missing room currently returns500.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:update
operations.behavior: Partially update a room via PUT or PATCH (same handler). Omitted/null optional fields preserve values; users/states arrays synchronize membership/states. Before start, timing/state edits reset lifecycle; after start progress is retained. Missing room currently returns500.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:end
operations.behavior: End current room; requires teacher/admin/manager role or current LMS teacher in addition to permission. Returns200 {status,message} without data; absent room returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_own; aliases room:read
operations.behavior: Queue a server-authorized interaction for an unmuted participant in an active room. Reuse event_id only for identical interaction/content; changed or pending retries return409. content max4096 encoded bytes; disabled interactions return422. Asset receipt returns unchanged.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:start_interactive; aliases room:read_own
operations.behavior: Start interactive state for a current room participant after asset checks; no request body. Returns200 {status,message} without data; missing room/client returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_livekit_token; aliases room:read, room:read_all, room:read_own
operations.behavior: Issue fresh LiveKit participant token after preview/participant checks and asset admission. Ended room returns empty token. chat_model_ref/chat_assistant_id/realtime are omitted when unavailable; membership and provider grants are enforced server-side.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_own; aliases room:read, room:read_all
operations.behavior: Read active seconds, earned coins and asset names per participant; this handler has no extra room-membership check beyond declared permission.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_livekit_token; aliases room:read, room:read_all, room:read_own, room_recording:read, room_recording:read_all, room_recording:read_own
operations.behavior: Issue LiveKit preview/participant token after preview/membership checks; ended room returns409 and missing room returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_own; aliases room:read, room:read_all
operations.behavior: Read current participant mute status; expired mute becomes null. Authenticated user and existing participant are required; absent participant returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:end; aliases room:update, room:read, room:read_own
operations.behavior: Mute/unmute a student as teacher/admin/manager or current LMS teacher. Self mute returns400, staff targets403, unverifiable LMS staff503. Returns nullable muted_until.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_playback; aliases room:read, room:read_all, room:read_own, room_recording:read, room_recording:read_all, room_recording:read_own
operations.behavior: Read full playback room/states after preview and readiness checks. Classroom session IDs can resolve through LMS. Unready/untimed composition returns409; timestamps include nullable available_until.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read; aliases room:read_all, room:read_own
operations.behavior: Read joined/left activity-log events for an authorized previewer or participant, sorted by timestamp then ID. Output timestamps are UTC; missing room returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room_recording:read; aliases room_recording:read_all, room_recording:read_own, room:read_recordings
operations.behavior: Read recording list and analyses after recording permission and current membership/global/admin checks; presigned URLs are returned, with model-produced analysis JSON.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:stop
operations.behavior: Stop room using its registered GET route and return200 data.room. This operation mutates state; missing room returns404.

operations.auth: IDP Bearer token or secure cookie via shared FaiberClient; room:read_analytics
operations.behavior: Read ongoing sessions, today sessions and distinct ongoing/today connected users from repository activity and room records.

operations.auth: LiveKit webhook Authorization signature; preserve exact body bytes
operations.behavior: Receive signed LiveKit webhook raw bytes; preserve the signed body exactly and supply Authorization. Invalid/missing signature returns401. Success returns200 {status,message} without data; this is server-to-server transport.

operations.auth: Current IDP Bearer authority session:summary_access:manage; source binding and downstream collector checks
operations.behavior: Read native observation policy with current IDP Bearer authority session:summary_access:manage; cookie-only and spoofed actor headers are insufficient. Binding is source-owned; this is not an MCP session.

operations.auth: Current IDP Bearer authority session:summary_access:manage; source binding and downstream collector checks
operations.behavior: Save native observation policy with optimistic expected_revision (stale409), required reason max1024 Unicode characters, and current collector session:summary:read validation when enabling. After503 reload current state before retrying; mutation may have committed.

operations.auth: Current IDP Bearer authority session:summary_access:manage; source binding and downstream collector checks
operations.behavior: Revoke one native summary object with required reason max1024 Unicode characters. Revocation survives policy disable/re-enable. Reload current state after503 because mutation can commit before status reconciliation fails.

operations.auth: Current IDP Bearer authority session:summary_access:manage; source binding and downstream collector checks
operations.behavior: Restore a native summary object using JSON DELETE body with required reason max1024 Unicode characters. Reload after503; restored status can lag reconciliation.

operations.auth: Extracted IDP actor; Session room/peer authorization plus target-service current authorization
operations.behavior: Forward opaque peer bytes through Session actor extraction to chat/asset/profile/drm/lms; explicit HTTP method and separate query. Body max2MiB (413); missing configured Chat/DRM/LMS or upstream failure502; unknown peer404. Chat room grants enforce membership and filter collections; DRM path-based read grants do not prove room membership. Response headers are allowlisted; SDK buffers upstream streams.

operations.auth: No local permission requirement; production auth context middleware still runs
operations.behavior: Read public liveness and hard-coded service version; no database readiness probe.

operations.auth: No local permission requirement; production auth context middleware still runs
operations.behavior: Read Flow integration queue/events from the pinned infera-flow-sdk model; mounted at root /integration/flow.
